title: Havana Bay ensemble model: public data, configuration and results
description: Digitised 19th-century soundings (2640), bathymetric products, SCHISM mesh and configuration, ERA5 and EOT20 forcing, Saltelli ensemble design and results for Havana Bay (Cuba), built exclusively from public data. Code under MIT; data under CC BY 4.0 (third-party data keep their licences, see DATA_SOURCES.md).
